correctness.rationale: The sum over z=2,...,14 of floor(z/2) is 49, with one test for a=b. I independently represented the 3^13 normalized ternary words as bits of a single integer. For each equation its violation mask is the union over hues of the intersection of the three position masks. Updating the zero- and one-defect masks by Z'=Z\B and O'=(O\B)∪(Z∩B) after each equation counts exhaustively, including when a=b. Final popcounts are 0 and 1350; intersecting O with each violation mask reproduced every one of the 49 CSV rows, with 29 positive rows and seven zeros ending at 14. Counts for 5+5=10 and 6+7=13 are 222 and 4 before normalization is undone. Cyclic relabeling gives exactly one representative with c(1)=0 per orbit of size three, hence 4050 named. The surviving [1,13] prefix mask independently gives six named-normalized classes, with the blocks in the result and 2,2,3 violations for the three possible hues of 14 up to permutation. Thus no one right-hand-side-14 deletion can suffice. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/schur_bitset_reproduction.py <frozen directory>/critical_triples.csv. The frozen programs were inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: Finite count for exactly the stated equation and color conventions; nothing here concerns simultaneous deletions or larger intervals.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Neither an asymptotic minimum, a modular threshold nor a generalized threshold yields a per-equation count for the standard system under review. The full text of the generalized-threshold paper was inaccessible, so the comparison is to its abstract only.

evidence: Each of Kisner's fixed color classes supplies two monochromatic sum-14 pairs, establishing the seven endpoint zeros mechanically.
For deletions with z<14, the restriction to [1,13] need not be defect-free, so Kisner's classification no longer confines it to those three partitions.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Credit the endpoint consequence to the prior structural classification. The earlier results do not imply the complete spectrum of positive and zero rows or one-defect multiplicities without new exact work.

value.rationale: The first unsatisfiable three-color Schur interval is canonical, not a chosen arbitrary cutoff. Single-equation sensitivity is an exact way to distinguish indispensable constraints from redundant constraints in that benchmark. The exact survivor multiplicities for all equations quantify how deletion changes the solution set, which a threshold, one UNSAT certificate, or one minimal core does not provide. The full census, not the already implied endpoint fact in isolation, supplies the value.
residual_risks: Does not enumerate minimal unsatisfiable subsets, nor imply general behavior at other palettes or thresholds.
